title: State Parts Tax Table for Wayfare Repair Schedule Estimates (Cleaning and Damage Fees)
content:
**Rule.** The parts tax of a Wayfare repair schedule estimate on a Cleaning and Damage Fees damage report is read from the state of the market the reported trip started in: Phoenix and Tucson (Arizona) take the Arizona parts tax rate; Las Vegas (Nevada) takes the Nevada parts tax rate; any other market takes the standard parts tax rate.

| Market the trip started in | Code on the trip record | State | Parts tax rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Phoenix, Tucson | PHX, TUS | Arizona | 8.6% |
| Las Vegas | LAS | Nevada | 8.38% |
| Denver, Colorado Springs, Salt Lake City, Albuquerque, or any other market | DEN, COS, SLC, ABQ or other | — | 7.25% (standard) |

The market is the metro market on the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares). The parts tax is added to the parts amount of the estimate.

**Worked figures (hypothetical parts amount of $152.00).**

| Market | Parts tax | Parts amount with tax |
|---|---|---|
| Phoenix | 8.6% | $165.072 |
| Las Vegas | 8.38% | $164.7376 |
| Denver | 7.25% | $163.02 |
